verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own docs describe a self-hosted mode that runs the review agent inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud. On Enterprise self-hosted deployments you can also opt out of all data retention, which effectively lets you control where code-related data lives. But this is an Enterprise-only deployment model, not a residency or region choice within the hosted service. missing for 10: region/residency selection for the cloud service, explicit data-residency documentation (regions, where learnings and review context are stored), availability below Enterprise, independent corroboration.
